verdict.rationale: Square documents self-serve signup with a Web Payments SDK, Card Payments API, and prebuilt eCommerce integrations that 'can be completed in just a few clicks,' plus a Sandbox for immediate testing—consistent with a founder going from signup to live online card acceptance quickly without sales calls. Missing for 10: explicit 'time-to-first-payment' documentation or independent/hands-on account of actual signup-to-live timing.
